tokens.name: ground-000
tokens.usage: The sheet. Page and plugin background. Paper is the Drafting skin's paper; Phosphor is the terminal black with its faint green cast.

tokens.name: ground-100
tokens.usage: A recess: a well a control sits in, a card fill, a hover fill. Stigmergy's deep phosphor; the Drafting skin's first elevation.

tokens.name: ground-200
tokens.usage: The section fill: what a cut face is hatched on. From the CAD sheets' FILL. The phosphor value is new to this system, between deep and dim.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, every outline, every pointer. Ink on paper; phosphor on the terminal. The outline of a solid is always ink.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, notes, metadata, the hairline of a nested card.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary: tick marks, grid, hatching. On Phosphor it is barely visible on purpose; never body text.

tokens.name: ink-bright
tokens.usage: A heading at full weight, a selected value's text, the lit tip of a pointer. Stigmergy's white phosphor.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline that is the card. Frames, title-block cells, table rules. Borders are 1px; the sheet frame is 2px.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: A dashed divider or a scale's minor ticks. Softer than rule; never a container's edge.

tokens.name: slab-face
tokens.usage: A solid surface: a knob's disc, a fader cap, a button top, a panel of a 3D case. Matte, outlined in ink. New to this system: the way out of the text-mode look for anything with mass.

tokens.name: slab-light
tokens.usage: The one edge of a slab that catches light: the top 1px inset highlight. Never a gradient across the face.

tokens.name: slab-shade
tokens.usage: The underside of a slab, its 1px drop and the floor of a recess. Where a slab meets the sheet.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one lit thing in a view: the value arc on the knob being touched, the primary action. On Paper it is the Drafting skin's engineering red, which is also hold; on Phosphor the phosphor itself.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent: the inverted selected segment, the pressed latch.

tokens.name: source-design
tokens.usage: Provenance: DESIGN. A value someone chose and is free to change. The default colour of a dimension and a parameter readout. Alias of ink by value.

tokens.name: source-datasheet
tokens.usage: Provenance: DATASHEET. A value read from elsewhere: a maker's page on a sheet; the host's automation or a preset in a plugin. Also links and handles.

tokens.name: source-assumed
tokens.usage: Provenance: ASSUMED. A nominal figure the calipers will correct; in a plugin a modulated or smoothed value not at rest. Stigmergy's amber: unread, warning.

tokens.name: source-measure
tokens.usage: Provenance: MEASURE. Not known yet; shows in red and holds the build. In a plugin: clipping, a missing input, an error, the on-air dot. Use sparingly or the spell breaks.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Passed, within tolerance, signal present. On Phosphor it is the phosphor; say OK with a glyph as well as a colour.

tokens.name: scope-ground
tokens.usage: The scope window is always the terminal, on either ground: the one lit screen set into the sheet. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: scope-grid
tokens.usage: The scope's graticule. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: scope-trace
tokens.usage: The scope's trace, with the CRT bloom. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: scope-trace-2
tokens.usage: A second trace on the scope: amber against phosphor, the two colours a terminal had.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background: inverted, no radius.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection foreground.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical 1 (amber) for an unordered series in a chart. From Loudon Live's palette: deep on paper, lit on dark. Up to six; beyond that, facet.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical 2 (green).

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical 3 (blue).

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical 4 (violet).

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical 5 (magenta).

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical 6 (coral).

families.mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.terminal: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: The title block's name. Uppercase, set in the markup.

styles.name: sheet-subtitle
styles.sample: PARTS.md row 7 · registers on the rotor OD
styles.usage: Under the title: what it is and what it registers on.

styles.name: sheet-eyebrow
styles.usage: A view's caption, a panel's label, a knob's name. Uppercase in the markup.

styles.name: sheet-dim
styles.usage: A dimension label and a parameter readout: the number, its unit, its tolerance.

styles.name: sheet-note
styles.sample: 3 HOLD: the bolt holes. No STL until someone measures it.
styles.usage: Numbered notes under a view. A HOLD note is set in source-measure.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-heading; uppercase in the markup, as Stigmergy sets it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text; tick labels on a scale.

styles.name: term-body
styles.usage: A board post, a log, agent output on the Phosphor ground. IBM Plex Mono, ligatures off, the row 1.4em.

styles.name: term-strong
styles.usage: A handle or hotkey in a terminal line.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: VT323 at banner size: a splash, a plugin's about screen. Pixelation is a register, not a default; never body.

styles.name: splash
styles.usage: An oversized numeral or two-word mark.

spacing.note: A 4px base, the subset of Loudon Live's scale a plugin face needs. Vertical rhythm in text is the row, 1.4em.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control; a tick's length.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a readout; between knobs in a tight row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A title-block cell's padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A panel's padding; between controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A section's margin on a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: The sheet margin on a plugin face at 1x.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: A page's top margin.

radius.note: Square is the house. A radius means a turned part.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything drawn: cards, panels, title block, buttons, readouts, the scope frame.

tokens.name: radius-bevel
tokens.usage: The one softening allowed on a slab's edge, a fader cap or a toggle lever, so it reads as machined rather than cut from paper.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: A knob, an LED, a jack: a turned part is a circle. Nothing else is round.

stroke.note: Line weights, from the sheets. Chosen for the screen; the SVG sheets use mm.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: The sheet frame and the title block's outer edge. Stigmergy's primary container used 3px double; here one heavier line.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: The visible outline of a solid: a knob's disc, a slab's edge in SVG or canvas.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: nested cards, table rules, dimension and extension lines, hatching.

tokens.name: stroke-pointer
tokens.usage: A knob's pointer and a fader's index line.

shadow.note: Elevation is a highlight on the top edge and a line under the bottom: a slab lifted a millimetre off the sheet. No soft drop shadows, no glow on neutral text.

tokens.name: shadow-slab
tokens.usage: A slab at rest: knob disc, fader cap, button top.

tokens.name: shadow-recess
tokens.usage: A well: a fader slot, a meter trough, a pressed button.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The CRT bloom, as a box-shadow for an LED or the scope's frame. Phosphor things only; the scope carries it on either ground.
